title: Require owner in validateApp and pass team from all three apps

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing or empty. core-shell, billing and reports pass owner matching their package.json team (platform/payments/insights). Single PR #1 because shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time. Local builds of all three apps passed, and CI and CD succeeded. Assumptions: the team values are hardcoded in source rather than read from package.json; the dependency catalog had no external consumers of validateApp.
